player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''crummyplayer''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.
description: it's ewoks, and why the heck not?
cards: posted: 2 were you looking for me
What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?
posted: what are you tryin to push on us
notes: Tagged Light (Ewok deck); the draft's Dark side was wrong.

Starting cards as posted under 'starting (3)': Careful Planning (starting effect), Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut and Endor: Ewok Village; they count toward the 60. No objective; Endor: Ewok Village is shown as the starting location.

Posted 'E<site>' names are Endor sites (e.g. 'Echirpys hut' dested Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut, 'Elanding site' dested Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest), 'Elanding platform' dested Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay)).
Posted 'Eancient forest' is printed as written: Endor: Ancient Forest exists only as a Dark card, so it cannot be in this Light deck.
Posted '2 threepio' dested Threepio (Endor), the Endor Ewok-support Threepio (adds attrition per Ewok in battle); the Premiere card is C-3PO (See-Threepio).

Posted '2 qui-gon' dested Qui-Gon Jinn; 'qui-gons saber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine; Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is a later Reflections III card); 'wa/dodn' dested Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice; 'mechanic failure' dested Mechanical Failure.
The strategy's later update (TK-422 for one Ewok Spearman, adding It Could Be Worse / I Have A Really Bad Feeling About This) is not in the posted list and is not added.
Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 29 June 2001, before Coruscant; no Coruscant cards in the list.
